description: This file defines a PHP class PerformanceTrackerAPI within the OrangeHRM project, specifically under the Performance module's API namespace. It implements REST API endpoints for managing performance trackers, including listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting performance tracker entities. The class also handles validation rules and utilizes traits for authentication and date/time helpers. The file includes comprehensive inline documentation using OpenAPI annotations for API documentation purposes.

classes.name: PerformanceTrackerAPI
classes.description: A REST API endpoint class handling CRUD operations for performance trackers in the OrangeHRM system, including listing, creation, retrieval, updating, and deletion functionalities, with integrated validation and documentation.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a list of performance trackers with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new performance tracker with specified parameters and reviewers.

methods.name: setPerformanceTrackerParams
methods.description: Sets the basic parameters for a PerformanceTracker entity based on request data, including tracker name and employee number.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for listing performance trackers, including access permissions and sorting criteria.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve details of a specific performance tracker identified by ID.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Validation rule for fetching a single performance tracker by ID.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing performance tracker identified by ID, including updating reviewers and tracker name.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Validation rules for updating a performance tracker.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove one or more performance trackers based on provided IDs.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Validation rule for delete operation to ensure IDs are provided and correctly formatted.

methods.name: getCommonBodyParamRulesCollection
methods.description: Helper method that returns validation rules for common request body parameters like trackerName, empNumber, and reviewers.
